title: Operator Handoff
purpose: Move one approved workflow into bounded operation with a named owner, rollback path, and evidence receipt.
steps: Confirm the approved workflow version and ownership boundary.
Run the readiness tool and resolve every missing requirement.
Preview Runbook instantiation and review its deterministic receipt.
Execute only against the approved disposable or production target.
Attach verification evidence and record rollback disposition.
stopConditions: Target is not the explicitly approved workspace or data source
verification: instantiation receipt is stable across previews
live retries return existing instead of creating duplicates
webhook signature is verified before evidence is accepted
